# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 30 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Policy Update: BTO & EC Income Ceilings Raised

- **NDR 2026: BTO income ceiling raised to S$16,000, EC ceiling to S$18,000** - Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced at the National Day Rally that the HDB BTO income ceiling has been raised to S$16,000 and the Executive Condominium ceiling to S$18,000, expanding eligibility for public housing. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ndr-2026-bto-income-ceiling-raised-to-s16000-ec-ceiling-to-s18000/)

## HDB Resale: Record Prices Across Multiple Towns

- **Bedok 5-room HDB sets new record at $1.45M** - A five-room flat at 153B Bedok South Road sold for $1,450,000 ($1,192 psf) in August 2026, setting a new resale record for Bedok and surpassing the previous record set at the same block just three months earlier. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/bedok-5-room-hdb-sold-record-1-45m-same-block-broke-record-3-months-ago/)
- **Bishan's first 4-room flat to hit S$1.3M** - A 4-room HDB resale flat in Bishan sold for S$1.3 million in August 2026 — the first of its flat type in the town to reach that mark — at approximately S$1,271 psf, also setting a new town-wide psf record for 4-room flats. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bishan-4-room-hdb-records-first-1-3m-natura-loft/)
- **Pasir Ris records its first million-dollar 5-room flat at S$1.15M** - A 5-room DBSS flat at Block 530D Pasir Ris Drive 1 sold for S$1.15 million, marking Pasir Ris' first million-dollar transaction for the 5-room flat type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/pasir-ris-first-million-dollar-5-room-hdb-sale/)

## Private Market: Condo Resale & New Launches

- **Condo resale activity rebounds in July 2026 as prices edge lower** - Singapore's condo resale market saw more units change hands in July 2026, but overall prices edged lower, with resale volume remaining slightly below both last year's level and the typical monthly average. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-rebounds-in-july-2026-as-prices-edge-lower/)
- **Ten 2026 new launch condos still have units available, from $1.38M** - Eleven new launch condos in Singapore still have unsold units in 2026, with entry prices starting from $1,377,095 across projects including Vela Bay, Tengah Garden Residences and Narra Residences, spanning the CCR, RCR and OCR. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/10-new-launch-condos-from-2026-that-still-have-units-available-from-1-38m/)
